title: AREAS rejects non-reference constants at formula entry (0x800A03EC) and returns #VALUE! for runtime non-references
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, AREAS(reference) counts the disjoint areas of a reference (including multi-area unions such as (A1:B2,C3,A4) -> 3, and single-area selections from INDEX such as INDEX((A1:A3,C1:C3),1,1,2) -> 1), passes through an error value, returns #VALUE! when a reference-capable expression evaluates to a non-reference (such as AREAS(CHOOSE(1,5))), and rejects literal numbers, array constants, or arithmetic expressions in its argument slot at formula entry (COM 0x800A03EC). All 3,075 full-bank AREAS rows match.
basis: Measured in DnaCalc cfunc_m3_6 (reference_result and lookup_edges), dcb1l_language row 115, and crates/calc-fml/tests/fixtures/entry/excel-entry.tsv (Excel 16.0.20527.20088); 3,075/3,075 full-bank rows match.
